summary: Family communication app with AI-powered chat feature that analyzes conversations, provides remedies for problems using parliamentary language, includes a widget showing number of problems solved, and allows users to disable AI remedies
architectural_notes: AI chat feature requires integration with AI service for conversation analysis
Parliamentary language filter needed for AI responses
Problem tracking system required to count solved problems for widget

existing_features.title: Add a widget to the dashboard that displays the total number of problems solved, showing a count that can be updated when AI remedies are applied or problems are marked as resolved
Implement AI-powered chat analysis that detects problems in conversations and automatically generates remedy suggestions to help resolve the identified issues
Add a toggle control that allows users to enable or disable the AI remedy feature, preserving their preference across sessions

new_feature_requests.summary: AI chat analysis feature with problem remedies using parliamentary language
Widget displaying number of problems solved
Toggle to enable/disable AI remedies feature
Ensure all AI-generated remedy suggestions use only parliamentary language, maintaining formal, respectful, and dignified wording in all communications
